.procedures.description:
Collection of the default procedures for batch translation.
Procedures are functions that handle the translation process in the translation flow.
A procedure is an async function that accept one parameter, the batch of translation data and returns batch translation info.

getTranslationBatchData.description: Generates translation batch data for the given translator and options.

parameters.name: translator
parameters.description: The translator engine to be used for translation.

parameters.name: optionsonFinishedkeyColumntranslateOtherignoreTranslatedoverwritesaveOnEachBatchalwaysSparateFilefilterTagModefilterTagtargetColumnmaxRequestLengthfilestranslatiorOptions
parameters.description: Additional options for the translator engine.

parameters.name: onFinished
parameters.description: Callback function to be executed when the process finishes.

parameters.name: keyColumn
parameters.description: The column index containing the keys to be translated.

parameters.name: translateOther
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to translate other columns.

parameters.name: ignoreTranslated
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to ignore already translated rows.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to overwrite existing translations.

parameters.name: saveOnEachBatch
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to save after each batch.

parameters.name: alwaysSparateFile
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to always translate each file separately.

parameters.name: filterTagMode
parameters.description: Mode for filtering tags ('blacklist' or 'whitelist').

parameters.name: filterTag
parameters.description: Array of tags to filter rows.

parameters.name: targetColumn
parameters.description: The column index where translations will be placed.

parameters.name: maxRequestLength
parameters.description: Maximum length of the request to the translator engine.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Array of files to be processed. If not provided, defaults to checked or all files.

parameters.name: translatiorOptions
parameters.description: Additional options for the translator engine.

parameters.name: trans
parameters.description: The current translation instance.

returns.description: A promise that resolves to a two-dimensional array containing the translation batch data.

runProcedure.description: Run the procedure for the given batch.

parameters.name: procedureName
parameters.description: The name of the procedure.

parameters.description: The batch of translation data.

returns.description: A promise that resolves to the translated batch.

translate.description: Translate the given batch of translation data.
